profile.goodFor: evening out vocals, bass and buses; parallel compression with Dry/Wet

settings.name: Attack threshold
settings.what: level above which it starts turning the sound down

settings.name: Ratio
settings.what: how strongly it turns down above the threshold

settings.name: Attack time
settings.what: how fast it reacts; slower lets each hit's start through

settings.name: Knee
settings.what: how gently it starts: lower (more negative) is smoother

settings.name: Compression mode
settings.what: Down compresses loud parts (the usual); Up and Boost raise quiet parts

settings.name: Sidechain mode
settings.what: how the level is measured: peak, RMS (average) and others

settings.name: Dry/Wet balance
settings.what: dry to compressed: below 100% is parallel compression
